name: Aankh Micholi
description: Undercover cop Rukmini gets married into a traditional family as the 'Aadarsh Bahu. Oscillating dual lives, how long will she be able to maintain her cover?

videos.title: Rukmini's Rigorous Training
videos.overview: Rukmini undergoes rigid training by her father, sculpting her into a future IPS officer. Malhar's taunts about being an orphan affects Sumedh.

videos.title: A Shock for Rukmini
videos.overview: Rukmini collapses on seeing Vandana getting shot. Kesar is devastated by Vijay's death. Later, she rejects Sumedh upon discovering Vijay's deceit.

videos.title: Malhar Brings Sumedh Back
videos.overview: Sumedh motivates Rukmini to bring Vandana's killer to justice. Later, Malhar refuses to take his medicine and convinces Kesar to allow Sumedh into the house.

videos.title: Kesar Receives a Threat
videos.overview: Sumedh quits his education to take care of Vijay's tea stall. While Rukmini aspires to become an IPS officer, Kesar gets threatened by Dollar Seth.

videos.title: Malhar, Rukmini's Determination
videos.overview: Malhar and Rukmini get into a head-to-head competition to bag the best IPS Officer title. Kesar receives criticism for accepting Sumedh as her son.

videos.title: Malhar Expresses His Love to Rukmini
videos.overview: Malhar takes Sumedh's help to confess his feelings to Rukmini, but the latter says she needs more time. Elsewhere, Sumedh seeks Kesar's affection.

videos.title: Kesar Questions Preesha
videos.overview: Sumedh aids Rukmini's father in reclaiming stolen luggage from a thief. Kesar furiously confronts Preesha for cutting hair without her consent.

videos.title: Rukmini Spins Up a Story
videos.overview: Rukmini gets Sumedh's photo from her father and tells Malhar that the man in the photo is her boyfriend. Elsewhere, Kesar punishes Preesha for cutting her hair.

videos.title: Kesar Takes Up the Challenge
videos.overview: Kesar intends to win the local competition to keep her promise to Malhar but faces a challenge from her neighbour. Further, she panics after seeing a gun.

videos.title: Sumedh Helps Kesar
videos.overview: Kesar refuses to take Sumedh's help to win the contest, but he is determined to help keep her promise. Elsewhere, Rukmini faces some trouble in the race.

videos.title: Kesar Accepts Defeat
videos.overview: Kesar surprises everyone by forfeiting the trophy she won with Sumedh's help. Later, Rukmini, uncovering sabotage, successfully gets the saboteur terminated.

videos.title: Preesha Gets Caught
videos.overview: Sumedh finds Preesha in Western clothes with her friends and tries to sneak her into the house. However, Kesar catches Preesha red-handed and scolds her.

videos.title: Rukmini Makes a Mistake
videos.overview: Rukmini mistakenly places her heartfelt letter in Sumedh's pocket instead of Malihar's. Kesar and her family are excitedly ready for Malihar's arrival.

videos.title: Malhar Returns Home
videos.overview: Malhar confides in Sumedh about his feelings for Rukmini. Kesar celebrates Malhar's arrival and eagerly anticipates his return.

videos.title: Malhar Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Kesar blames Malhar for lying to her for Sumedh, but Malhar takes a stand and blames Kesar for always insulting Sumedh. Later, Sumedh fights with Malhar.

videos.title: Malhar Apologises to Kesar
videos.overview: Sumedh cooks a dessert for Malhar so that he can use it to apologise to Kesar. Elsewhere, Rukmini tries to impress Sonal by cooking her mother's recipe.

videos.title: Rukmini Is Ecstatic
videos.overview: Malhar gets thrilled by Rukmini's unique declaration of love towards him. When Sumedh helps Rukmini, they remember a shared memory from their childhood.

videos.title: Malhar Faces Kesar's Questions
videos.overview: Malhar nervously discloses Sumedh and Neeti's budding relationship to Kesar. Elsewhere, Rukmini admits her feelings for Malhar in front of her father.

videos.title: Sumedh Grows Happy
videos.overview: When Malhar invites Neeti to his home, Sumedh becomes overjoyed and gets lost in her thoughts. Rukmini sets out on her journey to achieve her dream.

videos.title: Rukmini in an Unforeseen Situation
videos.overview: Kesar makes preparations to welcome Neeti but refuses to accept Sumedh as her son. Rukmini faces a shocker as her senior officials suspend her from the post.

videos.title: Neeti Humiliates Sumedh
videos.overview: Neeti humiliates Sumedh and declares interest in Malhar. Meanwhile, Rukmini vows to reclaim her position after being disregarded by her senior.

videos.title: Kesar Makes a Promise
videos.overview: Kesar gets furious when Neeti insults Sumedh and promises to find the best wife for him in the next 15 days. Elsewhere, Rukmini gets terminated from her job.

videos.title: Rukmini's Dream Is Shattered
videos.overview: Rukmini has an emotional breakdown as her dream of becoming an IPS officer is shattered. Elsewhere, Sumedh takes an oath to reunite Malhar with his beloved.

videos.title: Rukmini's Request to Her Father
videos.overview: Kesar tells the matchmaker that she needs the perfect bride for Sumedh within 15 days. Later, Rukmini tries to convince her father that she is getting framed.

videos.title: Kesar Questions Sumedh
videos.overview: Kesar asks Sumedh to confess to her if Malhar is in a relationship, while Sumedh is unable to lie to her. Elsewhere, Rukmini's aunt makes a shocking suggestion.

videos.title: Rukmini's Father Falls Sick
videos.overview: Rukimini's aunt tells her about Sumedh and suggests she marry him. Humiliated at work, Rukmini's father collapses and gets hospitalised.

videos.title: Rukmini's Emotional Breakdown
videos.overview: Sumedh rushes to the hospital as Arvind suffers a heart attack. Later, Rukmini breaks down emotionally upon seeing Arvind's condition in the hospital.

videos.title: Rukmini Agrees to Get Married
videos.overview: When Arvind's health worsens, Rukmini anxiously gives her consent for marriage. On the other hand, Kesar is mesmerised seeing Rukmini's photo.

videos.title: Kesar to Meet Rukmini!
videos.overview: After seeing Rukmini's photo and her responsibility towards her family, Kesar decides to meet her. Meanwhile, Rukmini feels heartbroken at Malhar's conduct towards her.

videos.title: A Shocker for Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh calls Rukmini and asks her to meet him to discuss the future of her relationship with Malhar. However, Rukmini is shocked to see Sumedh at her house.

videos.title: Kesar's Test for Rukmini
videos.overview: Kesar decides to evaluate Rukmini's skill in concealing her family's flaws by giving her a test. Later, Sumedh shares details about himself with Rukmini.

videos.title: Rukmini Faces a Dilemma
videos.overview: Malhar approves Sumedh and Rukmini's marriage. Later, Rukmini faces a dilemma when Kesar asks for her consent to the marriage.

videos.title: Rukmini, Sumedh's Engagement
videos.overview: Amid family pressure, Rukmini reluctantly exchanges rings with Sumedh. Later, he attempts to meet her to clear misunderstandings, but she refuses to see him.

videos.title: Rukmini's Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: Piyush comforts Rukmini when she weeps as her dream to catch Vandana's killer gets shattered. Later, Rukmini feels disheartened during her Haldi ceremony.

videos.title: Kesar Sympathises with Rukmini
videos.overview: Rukmini gets frightened by the red colour in the saree from Kesar and discards it. Upon understanding Rukmini's trauma, Kesar opposes all to offer her sympathy.

videos.title: Sumedh, Rukmini's Wedding
videos.overview: Despite her anxiety about the future, Rukmini gets ready to tie the knot with Sumedh. Later, Sumedh assists Piyush by making tea at his wedding.

videos.title: A Shocker for Piyush
videos.overview: Rukmini is overjoyed by her father's visit before the wedding. Later, Piyush uncovers Sumedh's true occupation and confronts Sonal for hiding it.

videos.title: Rukmini, Sumedh's Wedding
videos.overview: Rukmini and Sumedh proceed to the wedding with their participation in different rituals. Malhar meets with an accident when he arrives at the wedding venue.

videos.title: Rukmini's Unusual Grihapravesh
videos.overview: Rukmini is overwhelmed by Kesar's behaviour with the women of the family. Later, a water crisis makes Rukmini mistakenly enter the house without a Grihapravesh.

videos.title: Sumedh's Request to Kesar
videos.overview: As everyone gets locked out of their rooms, Sumedh requests Kesar to sleep in his room. While Rukmini agrees, Kesar hesitates to ruin their wedding night.

videos.title: Kesar Criticises Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh enters the bathroom to help Rukmini, and they get scared when Kesar knocks on the door. Later, Kesar gets furious at Rukmini for being late.

videos.title: Rukmini's Trophies are Discarded
videos.overview: Kesar assists Rukmini in preparing for the ceremony, spotting her injury in the process. Further, she finds Rukmini's trophies and asks her to get over her past.

videos.title: Will Sumedh Help Rukmini?
videos.overview: Rukmini decides to seek Sumedh's help to fulfil her dream. Later, Kesar gets angry when Rukmini advises her about obeying traffic rules.

videos.title: Rukmini Faces Kesar's Wrath
videos.overview: Rukmini's daring chase after a thief leaves everyone stunned. But Kesar fumes in anger and lashes out at Rukmini for the same.

videos.title: Rukmini Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Sumedh aids Rukmini in making morning tea for the family. Later, Rukmini confronts Kesar for littering on her way to the temple.

videos.title: Rukmini Faces Humiliation
videos.overview: Kesar asks Rukmini to help her recover some lost money, but she gets blamed for stealing. Later, Rukmini decides to buy some thoughtful gifts for Sumedh.

videos.title: A Shocker for Rukmini
videos.overview: Rukmini is surprised when she sees that no one is wearing any uniform at Sumedh's felicitation ceremony. Later, Rukmini learns about Sumedh's occupation.

videos.title: Rukmini's Ambitious Goal
videos.overview: Rukmini rejects the idea of marrying Sumedh. Later, she discloses her aspiration to become an IPS officer, while Kesar exposes her family's betrayal.

videos.title: Rukmini Questions Fai's Deception
videos.overview: Shivani devices a plan to hide their mistake to evade Kesar's anger. Elsewhere, Rukmini emotionally breaks down and confronts Fai about the deception against her.

videos.title: Rukmini Uncovers the Truth
videos.overview: Rukmini is devastated when her educational certificates disappear from her Almirah. Her investigation unexpectedly unveils Shivani's scheme in front of everyone.

videos.title: Rukmini Accepts Her False Reality
videos.overview: Kesar demands Bhaven and Shivani's departure due to their deceit. Elsewhere, Rukmini decides to bury her dreams, embracing the falsehood of her current life.

videos.title: Rukmini's Rebellious Move
videos.overview: Kesar gets furious at Preesha for misbehaving at the dinner table and attempts to hit her However, Rukmini stops Kesar which makes the latter lose her calm.

videos.title: Sumedh Learns Rukmini's Truth
videos.overview: Rukmini confronts Sonal and her aunt, furious at their deception regarding Sumedh and his family. Later, Sumedh stumbles upon a photo of Rukmini in an IPS uniform.

videos.title: Kesar's Startling Ultimatum
videos.overview: Rukmini's anxiety mounts as the police come to hand over her certificates to Kesar. Later, Rukmini gets dumbfounded as Kesar delivers a startling ultimatum.

videos.title: Sumedh's Night of Despair
videos.overview: Sumedh feels shattered by Rukmini's unexpected reaction on their special night. Later, Kesar gets furious as Rukmini wakes up late the next morning.

videos.title: Rukmini Defends Her Father
videos.overview: Rukmini gives a stern reply when Kesar questions her upbringing and insults Arvind. Later, Sumedh burns his hands to avoid applying colour to Rukmini against her will.

videos.title: Shivani's Plan to Humiliate Rukmini
videos.overview: Shivani serves Rukmini a glass of special Thandai to intoxicate her. Later, Sumedh stands up for Rukmini when the neighbours insult her for being drunk.

videos.title: Rukmini's Fear of Exposure
videos.overview: Rukmini panics about her secret getting exposed as Kesar asks Preesha to contact Arvind. Later, the Thakkars get overjoyed to learn the news of Malhar's return.

videos.title: Malhar Returns Home
videos.overview: Sumedh reminisces about a childhood encounter as Rukmini tries to comfort him. Later, Rukmini and Malhar are surprised to find each other in their house.

videos.title: Rukmini Decides to Confess
videos.overview: Kesar is pleased by Rukmini's cooking skills and gifts her a bangle. As the situation turns uneasy with Malhar, Rukmini decides to tell the truth to Sumedh.

videos.title: Malhar Becomes Doubtful
videos.overview: Malhar shares his heartbreak with Sumedh, who conveys marital woes with Rukmini. Malhar doubts Rukmini's relationship with Sumedh when he notices an extra bed.

videos.title: Malhar Ambushes Rukmini
videos.overview: Malhar finds Rukmini alone at the market and confronts her about her feelings for him. Later, he urges Sumedh to take a trip to Mumbai with a hidden motive.

videos.title: Sumedh Faces Heartbreak
videos.overview: Malhar advises Rukmini to divorce Sumedh and hands her the papers. Later, Sumedh experiences heartbreak upon discovering the documents in his room.

videos.title: Sumedh Confronts Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh informs the family about his decision to move to Mumbai for business. Subsequently, he seeks an explanation from Rukmini for her wish to divorce him.

videos.title: Sumedh Decides to Stay
videos.overview: In her attempt to stop Sumedh from leaving, Rukmini sustains an injury. Despite Sumedh's decision to stay, Malhar blames Rukmini for influencing Sumedh.

videos.title: Malhar's Wicked Intent
videos.overview: Rukmini confesses the truth about the divorce papers to Sumedh. Meanwhile, Malhar, intent on stirring trouble, plans a party celebrating Rukmini and Sumedh's wedding.

videos.title: Kesar Confronts Rukmini
videos.overview: Kesar gets furious at Rukmini for lying to her and decides to break off the marriage. However, Sumedh stops Kesar and claims that Rukmini told him everything.

videos.title: Rukmini's New Choice
videos.overview: Rukmini gets cornered by some officers who offer her a job as an undercover agent for the country. However, Rukmini rejects the offer and accepts Kesar's terms.

videos.title: Rukmini Fasts for Sumedh
videos.overview: After Kesar gives Rukmini a month to prove herself, she vows to reunite Sumedh and the former. Rukmini keeps fast for Sumedh for his healthy life.

videos.title: Kesar Learns Rukmini's Past
videos.overview: Rukmini stops Malhar from committing suicide, and Kesar appreciates Rukmini's actions. Later, Kesar learns about Rukmini's affair in the IPS academy.

videos.title: Sumedh, Malhar's Heated Clash
videos.overview: Sumedh explodes in anger when Kesar unveils Rukmini's past. Later, on learning about Rukmini and Malhar's past, a conflict ensues between Sumedh and Malhar.

videos.title: Sumedh's Firm Stand for Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh defends Rukmini against Kesar's accusations and gives an apt reply to her. Later, Rukmini vows to ensure Sumedh's rightful place in Kesar's life.

videos.title: Kesar Reveals Her Will
videos.overview: Rukmini helps Sumedh in selecting a meaningful birthday present for Kesar. When Kesar discloses the distribution of her assets, Sumedh declines his portion.

videos.title: Sumedh to Leave the House?
videos.overview: Sumedh promises Kesar to leave the house for good so that she doesn't have to see his face anymore. Later, Rukmini asks Kesar to disown Sumedh legally.

videos.title: Kesar Confesses her Love for Sumedh
videos.overview: Kesar refuses to disown Sumedh as she confesses that she loves him like a son. Later, Sumedh informs Kesar that Malhar got kidnapped by a group of criminals.

videos.title: Rukmini Saves Malhar
videos.overview: Rukmini bravely fights the criminals holding Malhar hostage and successfully rescues him. Later, Sumedh and Malhar plead with Kesar to let Rukmini fulfill her dream.

videos.title: Dream Comes True for Rukmini
videos.overview: Kesar gives her blessings to Rukmini as the latter gets ready for her first day as an IPS officer. Later, Rukmini's father comes to meet Rukmini and salutes her.

videos.title: Rukmini’s Romantic Surprise for Sumedh
videos.overview: Rukmini decorates the house to surprise Sumedh and tells him she wants to marry him again. Later, she is shocked to see a tattoo on Kesar’s arm.

videos.title: Are Rukmini’s Suspicions True?
videos.overview: Rukmini questions Kesar about Vijay’s death and tries to connect the dots. Later, Sumedh learns about Rukmini suspecting Kesar of her mother's murder.

videos.title: Sumedh Rejects the Evidence
videos.overview: Rukmini shows Sumedh the evidence which proves that Kesar killed Rukmini's mother. Later, Rukmini accuses Kesar of murder when Sumedh refuses to believe the evidence.

videos.title: Rukmini's Emotional Decision
videos.overview: Sumedh buries the evidence against Kesar to prevent Rukmini from arresting her. However, Rukmini reveals that she has already changed her mind about arresting Kesar.
